user_stories.goal: Read, write and remove metadata on ReGa objects (Interface.getMetadata/setMetadata/removeMetadata) and on interface-stored objects (Interface.getMetadata_crRFD/setMetadata_crRFD)
acceptance: GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Interface.getMetadata is called with objectId and dataId THEN a ReGa script returns o.MetaData(dataId) for dom.GetObject(objectId) as a JSON string (getmetadata.tcl:13-23; methods.conf:439-444)
GIVEN the objectId does not resolve to a ReGa object WHEN getMetadata runs THEN the string 'No metadata available' is returned (getmetadata.tcl:18-20)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Interface.setMetadata is called THEN existing metadata dataId is removed then re-added with value on the ReGa object and the string '<dataId>: <value>' is returned (setmetadata.tcl:11-27; methods.conf:432-437)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and an existing metadata entry WHEN Interface.removeMetadata is called THEN it is removed and '<objectId> - matadata <dataId> successfully deleted!' is returned (removemetadata.tcl:10-21; methods.conf:462-467)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Interface.setMetadata_crRFD is called with interface, objectId, dataId, value THEN xmlrpc setMetadata is invoked and its raw result is returned (setmetadata_crRFD.tcl:12-18; methods.conf:446-452); a GUEST session can read via getMetadata_crRFD (getmetadata_crRFD.tcl:11-16; methods.conf:454-460)

GIVEN Interface.setMetadata {objectId:'NEQ0123456', dataId:'x', value:'y'} WHEN the schema validates THEN dataId must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$ (locked, BD-02/BD-10) and the value is escaped exactly once by the unified escape routine [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN Interface.setMetadata targets an objectId that does not exist THEN the script creates a new ReGa object (OT_OBJECT) named objectId and stores the metadata on it, i.e. a write side effect creating arbitrary named objects (setmetadata.tcl:19-23)

WHEN removeMetadata targets a missing object THEN 'o.MetaData(dataId)' is evaluated on a null object (no null check at removemetadata.tcl:11-12); hmscript_run returns '' on script failure (hmscript.tcl:33-37), so the response would be '""' (ReGa behavior on the null dereference unverified)

WHEN the three ReGa-based methods are called THEN they are registered with SCRIPT_FILE pointing directly to the method file (not dispatch.tcl), so no 'interface' argument is needed or validated (methods.conf:432-467)

WHEN the crRFD variants call xmlrpc THEN they are not wrapped in checkXmlRpcStatus: faults raise a Tcl error returned as 200 internal error; setMetadata_crRFD passes $value raw instead of [list string $value] and returns the unquoted raw result (setmetadata_crRFD.tcl:16-18; getmetadata_crRFD.tcl:14-16)
WHEN value or dataId contain quotes/backslashes/newlines THEN hmscript_escapeString escapes them before injection as ReGa 'var' declarations (hmscript.tcl:62-71)
WHEN getMetadata is called at GUEST level THEN any ReGa object's metadata can be read by object id (methods.conf:439-440)

input_shape.objectId: string; ReGa object id or name, usually a device/channel serial or address

output_shape.crRFD variants: raw XML-RPC result (unquoted for set, JSON string for get)

user_stories.goal: Read the ReGa device model: device ids, single-device detail, bulk detail with channels, new-device count and address lookups (Device.listAll, listAllDetail, get, getNewDeviceCount, getReGaIDByAddress, getRFAddressByAddress, getRFAddressOfAllDevices)
acceptance: GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Device.listAll is called THEN the ids of all ReGa devices with ReadyConfig()==true are returned as a JSON string array (listall.tcl:12-38; methods.conf:497-501)

GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Device.listAllDetail is called THEN for each ready device with an existing interface a separate ReGa script is executed and a device object {id,name,address,interface,type,operateGroupOnly,isReady,channels[]} is built, each channel carrying id,name,address,deviceId,index,partnerId,mode,category,isReady,isUsable,isVisible,isLogged,isLogable,isReadable,isWritable,isEventable,isAesAvailable,isVirtual,channelType (listalldetail.tcl:170-282; methods.conf:503-508)
GIVEN a GUEST session and device id WHEN Device.get is called THEN the same device/channel model for a single device is returned (device/get.tcl:17-177; methods.conf:510-515)

GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Device.getNewDeviceCount is called THEN the count of enabled devices that are not ReadyConfig and not named 'Gateway' is returned as a JSON string (getnewdevicecount.tcl:13-28; methods.conf:490-495)
GIVEN an ADMIN session and a serial address WHEN Device.getReGaIDByAddress is called THEN the matching device ID() is returned (getregaidbyaddress.tcl:13-26; methods.conf:524-529)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.getRFAddressByAddress or Device.getRFAddressOfAllDevices is called THEN the RF_ADDRESS token(s) parsed from the DEVDESC metadata are returned (getrfaddressbyaddress.tcl:13-38; getrfaddressofalldevices.tcl:13-36)
GIVEN Device.get is called with an id that has no matching ReGa device WHEN the script returns no NAME THEN jsonrpc_error 501 'device not found' is returned (device/get.tcl:129-131)

GIVEN GET /api/v2/model?limit=50&offset=100 with Content-Type-free GET, header X-Session-Id of a GUEST session, header X-Requested-With and a system with 120 ready devices WHEN processed THEN HTTP 200 JSON {"devices":{"total":120,"offset":100,"limit":50,"items":[20 device objects each with channels]},"channels":...,"rooms":...,"functions":...,"sysvars":...,"programs":...} where every section carries total/offset/limit/items (shape locked, BD-13); devices are produced by ONE bulk ReGa script, not one hmscript per device [V2]
GIVEN GET /api/v2/model?sections=devices,rooms WHEN processed THEN only the requested sections are present in the response [V2]
GIVEN GET /api/v2/model without a valid session WHEN processed THEN HTTP 401 and no ReGa script is executed [V2]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN Device.listAllDetail executes THEN one hmscript (ReGa) round-trip is made per device (N+1 pattern) and any device whose script output cannot be parsed into an array is silently skipped (listalldetail.tcl:188-208)

WHEN Device.listAllDetail reads a device whose operateGroupOnly metadata is null THEN the read call writes it (AddMetaData operateGroupOnly=false); for HmIP-DRG-DALI and HmIP-FALMOT channels it also writes maxCap/chnActive defaults, so a GUEST-level read mutates ReGa metadata (listalldetail.tcl:33-35, 147, 158)

WHEN a channel Label contains 'HmIP-FALMOT' with channelType CLIMATECONTROL_FLOOR_TRANSCEIVER but is not exactly HmIP-FALMOT-C8/C12 THEN the Tcl side reads channel(FALMOT_CHN_ACTIVE) which the ReGa side never wrote, raising a Tcl error that fails the whole list as 200 internal error (listalldetail.tcl:152, 268-270)
WHEN isVirtual is computed THEN listAllDetail also flags Label 'HmIP-RCV-50' as virtual while Device.get flags only ChannelType()==29 (listalldetail.tcl:94 vs device/get.tcl:95)
WHEN GROUP_PARTNER_ID is 65535 THEN partnerId is emitted as an empty string (device/get.tcl:148-149; listalldetail.tcl:234-235)

WHEN Device.getReGaIDByAddress finds no device THEN the literal 'noDeviceFound' is returned as a normal result; getRFAddressByAddress returns 'unknown' (getregaidbyaddress.tcl:15; getrfaddressbyaddress.tcl:15, 30-34)

WHEN Device.getRFAddressOfAllDevices runs THEN it calls 'hmscript $script' without args and returns a tab/newline separated string 'RF_ADDRESS..<tab>address<tab>name<newline>' per device (getrfaddressofalldevices.tcl:28, 36)
WHEN ReGa script fails or returns nothing for Device.listAll / getNewDeviceCount THEN hmscript_run returns '' and an empty array / quoted empty string is returned (hmscript.tcl:33-37)
WHEN device channels include Internal() channels THEN they are excluded from channel lists (device/get.tcl:47; listalldetail.tcl:46)
WHEN the ReGa field isReady for the device is emitted in listAllDetail THEN it is a quoted string, whereas channel isReady is an unquoted raw ReGa boolean (listalldetail.tcl:222 vs 246)
WHEN /api/v2/model is requested with limit=0 or limit above the configured maximum THEN HTTP 422 with error 403 "invalid argument (limit)" (maximum fixed in blueprint, EG-13) [V2]
WHEN Device.listAllDetail is called on v1 THEN behaviour and N+1 cost are preserved (frozen); the bulk path is only /api/v2/model [TARGET]

output_shape.listAllDetail / get: device: {id: string, name: string, address: string, interface: string, type: string, operateGroupOnly: string ('true'|'false'|''), isReady?: string, channels: channel[]}; channel: {id, name, address, deviceId: string, index: integer, partnerId: string, mode: 'MODE_DEFAULT'|'MODE_AES', category: 'CATEGORY_NONE'|'CATEGORY_SENDER'|'CATEGORY_RECEIVER', isReady, isUsable, isVisible, isLogged, isLogable, isReadable, isWritable, isEventable, isAesAvailable, isVirtual: boolean (raw ReGa token), channelType: string, mode_multi_mode?: string, daliMaxCapabilities?: string, isChannelActive?: boolean}

user_stories.goal: Mutate ReGa device and channel attributes: names, visibility, usability, logging, AES mode and operate-group-only flag (Device.setName, setVisibility, setOperateGroupOnly; Channel.setName, setVisibility, setUsability, setLogging, setMode)
acceptance: GIVEN an ADMIN session, device/channel id and name WHEN Device.setName or Channel.setName is called THEN the ReGa object's Name() is set and the resulting (possibly uniquified) name is returned as a JSON string (device/setname.tcl:16-25; channel/setname.tcl:17-26; methods.conf:517-522, 714-719)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.setVisibility / Channel.setVisibility is called with isVisible THEN Visible(bool) is set and the resulting boolean is returned as JSON true/false (device/setvisibility.tcl:10-28; channel/setvisibility.tcl:10-28)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.setUsability is called with isUsable THEN UserAccessRights(iulOtherThanAdmin) is set to iarFullAccess (true) or iarRead (otherwise) and the effective state is returned as true/false (channel/setusability.tcl:10-34; methods.conf:741-746)
GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.setLogging is called with isLogged THEN ChnArchive(bool) is set and the effective state returned as true/false (channel/setlogging.tcl:10-28)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.setMode is called with mode 'MODE_AES' THEN ChnAESActive(true) is set, otherwise ChnAESActive(false), and 'MODE_AES' or 'MODE_DEFAULT' is returned (channel/setmode.tcl:10-37)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.setOperateGroupOnly is called with mode 'true' THEN metadata operateGroupOnly=true is written, otherwise false (device/setoperategrouponly.tcl:11-22; methods.conf:567-572)

GIVEN the ReGa script yields neither 'true' nor 'false' (or the AES mode names) WHEN the *Visibility, setUsability, setLogging or setMode methods run THEN jsonrpc_error 500 'homematic script error' is returned (e.g. channel/setvisibility.tcl:24-28; channel/setmode.tcl:33-37)

GIVEN Channel.setName called with {_session_id_, id:'1234'} and no 'name' WHEN the dispatcher validates arguments THEN 402 "missing argument (name)" is returned and no ReGa script runs (ARGUMENTS corrected to {_session_id_ id name}); likewise Channel.setMode without 'mode' returns 402 "missing argument (mode)" [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN a flag argument is the JSON boolean true THEN it arrives as the string 'true' and only the exact string 'true' sets the flag; any other value (including '1', 'True') means false (device/setvisibility.tcl:12; channel/setusability.tcl:12; channel/setlogging.tcl:12)
WHEN Device.setName or Channel.setName gets an id with no object THEN the script writes nothing and '""' is returned (no error) (device/setname.tcl:18-22)

WHEN Device.setOperateGroupOnly succeeds THEN the script writes nothing, so the result is the quoted empty string; it also returns '""' when the device does not exist (device/setoperategrouponly.tcl:15-22)
WHEN a name is not unique THEN ReGa uniquifies it and the returned name differs from the input (device/setname.tcl:12 doc)
WHEN Channel.setMode sets AES but the channel does not support it THEN the effective mode read back may remain MODE_DEFAULT (channel/setmode.tcl:20-27)
WHEN unusual characters appear in name THEN hmscript_escapeString escapes backslash, quotes, CR, LF, tab before ReGa injection (hmscript.tcl:62-71)
WHEN id is not found for visibility/usability/logging/mode THEN empty script output leads to 500 'homematic script error' (channel/setvisibility.tcl:27)

user_stories.goal: Report program/link usage of devices and channels and read channel facts (Device.hasPrograms, hasLinksOrPrograms, listProgramIds; Channel.hasProgramIds, listProgramIds, getName, getValue, getChannelType)
acceptance: GIVEN a GUEST session and device id WHEN Device.listProgramIds is called THEN the de-duplicated ids of all programs using any non-internal channel of the device are returned as a JSON string array (device/listprogramids.tcl:13-44; methods.conf:560-565)
GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.hasPrograms is called THEN true is returned iff any channel has ChnDPUsageCount() > 0 (device/hasprograms.tcl:12-35; methods.conf:553-558)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Device.hasLinksOrPrograms is called THEN true is returned if the device is used in programs; otherwise, if it has links, each channel>0 is queried over XML-RPC and true is returned iff a link peer belongs to a different parent device (not starting with '@') (haslinksorprograms.tcl:88-145; methods.conf:545-551)

GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Channel.hasProgramIds is called THEN raw true/false is returned depending on whether ChnEnumDPUsagePrograms() is non-empty (channel/hasprogramids.tcl:12-25; methods.conf:707-712)
GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Channel.listProgramIds is called THEN the program ids using the channel are returned as a string array (channel/listprogramids.tcl:12-39; methods.conf:700-705)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.getName is called with a channel address THEN the name of the first enabled+visible channel with that Address() is returned (channel/getname.tcl:12-37; methods.conf:721-726)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN Channel.getValue / Channel.getChannelType is called with id THEN obj.State() / obj.HssType() is returned as a JSON string (channel/getvalue.tcl:12-21; channel/getchanneltype.tcl:12-21; methods.conf:727-739)

GIVEN Device.hasLinksOrPrograms for a device whose interface is not one of BidCos-RF, BidCos-Wired, HmIP-RF, HmIP-Wired WHEN called THEN v1 keeps the Tcl error returned as a sanitised 200 (no 'ifaceList(URL)' text, correlation id instead); extending the interface table is not in the plan (EG-15) [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN Device.hasLinksOrPrograms handles a device on an interface other than BidCos-RF, BidCos-Wired, HmIP-RF or HmIP-Wired THEN getIfaceURL leaves ifaceList unset and 'can't read ifaceList(URL)' is raised -> 200 internal error (haslinksorprograms.tcl:13-22, 95)
WHEN a channel in hasLinksOrPrograms has direction other than 1/2 THEN the loop breaks and further links of that channel are ignored (haslinksorprograms.tcl:116-124)
WHEN hasLinksOrPrograms iterates links THEN getDeviceDescription is requested once per link for the same channel inside the loop (haslinksorprograms.tcl:110-113)

WHEN the device id is unknown THEN the Device.hasPrograms script guards with 'if (device)' and returns 'false', while Device.listProgramIds calls device.Channels() without a null check (device/hasprograms.tcl:16; device/listprogramids.tcl:14-18); the outcome of that null dereference in ReGa is unverified
WHEN Channel.hasProgramIds finds no channel THEN the script prints nothing and result is null (channel/hasprogramids.tcl:14-25; jsonrpc.tcl:87-91)
WHEN Channel.getName gets a hidden channel (not visible) THEN it is excluded by EnumEnabledVisibleIDs() and '""' is returned (channel/getname.tcl:23)
WHEN Channel.getValue / getChannelType id is not found THEN '""' is returned without error (channel/getvalue.tcl:14-17)

WHEN the stale copy www/api/methods/device/hasprograms.tcl is compared THEN it lacks the 'break' after hasPrograms = 'true' at line 22 (functionally the same result, loop continues) (device/hasprograms.tcl:22)

user_stories.goal: Start and poll communication (function) tests for devices and channels (Device.startComTest/pollComTest, Channel.startComTest/pollComTest)
acceptance: GIVEN a GUEST session and device id WHEN Device.startComTest is called THEN the current time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' is returned as the test id and DevStartComTest() is triggered (device/startcomtest.tcl:12-25; methods.conf:574-579)
GIVEN a GUEST session and channel id WHEN Channel.startComTest is called THEN the same test id is returned and ChnStartComTest() is triggered (channel/startcomtest.tcl:12-24; methods.conf:769-774)

GIVEN a started test WHEN Device.pollComTest(id,testId) is called and LastTestCompletedTime() >= testId THEN that completion timestamp is returned as a JSON string; otherwise raw JSON false is returned (device/pollcomtest.tcl:13-36; methods.conf:581-586)

GIVEN a started test WHEN Channel.pollComTest(id,testId) is called and TestCompletedTime() >= testId THEN the timestamp is returned, otherwise false (channel/pollcomtest.tcl:14-37; methods.conf:776-781)

GIVEN the ReGa object does not exist WHEN any of the four methods runs THEN the script prints nothing and jsonrpc_error 500 'homematic script error' is returned (device/startcomtest.tcl:24-28; device/pollcomtest.tcl:33; channel/pollcomtest.tcl:34)

GIVEN Device.pollComTest with testId '2026-10-13 12:00:00' WHEN validated THEN testId must match ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$ else error 403 "invalid argument (testId)" (locked, BD-02/BD-10) [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN testId is an arbitrary non-timestamp string THEN the ReGa >= comparison is evaluated on whatever types ReGa derives; no validation occurs (device/pollcomtest.tcl:15-19)
WHEN the clock of the CCU changes between start and poll THEN comparison may be wrong because the test id is wall-clock time with one-second resolution (device/startcomtest.tcl:17)

WHEN Device.startComTest or Channel.startComTest runs THEN the test id is written before DevStartComTest()/ChnStartComTest() is invoked, so the id is returned regardless of whether the test could be started (device/startcomtest.tcl:17-18; channel/startcomtest.tcl:16-17)
WHEN the doc comment of startComTest says 'Id des Kanals' for Device.startComTest THEN the argument is a device id (device/startcomtest.tcl:6)
WHEN comtest methods are called at GUEST level THEN guests can trigger RF transmissions (methods.conf:574-575, 769-770)

user_stories.goal: Per-session event queue: subscribe, poll and unsubscribe through file-backed queues under /tmp/event, with events produced by event_fire (init on subscribe, delete from hm_deldev)
acceptance: GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Event.subscribe is called THEN the session's queue file /tmp/event/<sid> is truncated, the subscriber list /tmp/event/subscriber.list gets <sid> -> {EVENT_COUNT 0}, event_fire 'init' is queued to subscribers and true is returned (subscribe.tcl:32-58; methods.conf:595-600)
GIVEN queued events for the session WHEN Event.poll is called THEN /tmp/event/<sid> is read, truncated and returned as [{type: <string>, data: <raw JSON>}] (poll.tcl:6-34; methods.conf:609-614)

GIVEN a subscribed session WHEN Event.unsubscribe is called THEN its queue file is deleted, its entry is removed from subscriber.list and true is returned (unsubscribe.tcl:13-27; methods.conf:602-607)

GIVEN a device is deleted WHEN rega/bin/hm_deldev runs THEN event_fire delete with data '"<device>"' appends a {TYPE delete DATA "<device>"} line to every subscriber queue whose EVENT_COUNT is below the limit 64 (eq3/event.tcl:22-43; src/webui/rega/bin/hm_deldev:17)
GIVEN the lock cannot be obtained WHEN subscribe/unsubscribe run THEN false is returned (unsubscribe.tcl:14-25 doc) and WHEN poll runs THEN '[]' is returned (poll.tcl:7-18)

GIVEN sessions A and B are both subscribed and valid WHEN session C calls Event.subscribe THEN the other-subscriber check uses hmscript_runFromFile('eq3/checksid.hms') (the existing api/eq3/checksid.hms), returns 'true' for A and B, and both subscriptions and queue files are retained; only subscribers whose checksid result is not 'true' are removed (regression test in CI) [TARGET]
GIVEN Event.subscribe completes WHEN it responds THEN the result is exactly JSON true (success) or false (lock not obtained), never a quoted debug string such as "<id> a" [TARGET]
GIVEN a subscribed session with 64 queued events WHEN Event.poll returns them THEN EVENT_COUNT is reset to 0 and the 65th event fired afterwards is delivered by the next poll [TARGET]

GIVEN a datapoint of channel 'NEQ0123456:1' named STATE changes from 0 to 1 WHEN the producer fires THEN every subscriber queue receives {TYPE datapoint.changed DATA {"address":"NEQ0123456:1","datapoint":"STATE","value":"1"}} and Event.poll returns it as {type:'datapoint.changed', data:{...}} (payload keys locked, BD-12; producer mechanism undefined, EG-2) [TARGET]

GIVEN GET /api/v2/events?timeout=25 with a valid sid and X-Requested-With WHEN the queue is empty THEN the CGI holds the connection until an event arrives or 25 s elapse and then answers HTTP 200 with the array of queued events (empty array on timeout); an invalid sid gives HTTP 401 (long-poll; parameter name and maximum locked, BD-09/BD-12; SSE only via the gated gateway) [V2]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN Event.unsubscribe is called for a session not in subscriber.list THEN 'unset subscriberList($id)' raises inside catch, subscriber.list is not rewritten and false is returned (unsubscribe.tcl:17-23)

WHEN event data is emitted THEN data is inserted into the JSON verbatim (not escaped); hm_deldev embeds the unescaped device argument inside quotes, so a device name with a quote or backslash produces invalid JSON in Event.poll (poll.tcl:27; hm_deldev:17)
WHEN the module event.tcl is loaded and subscriber.list does not exist THEN /tmp/event is created and the list file is truncated/created (eq3/event.tcl:49-52)
WHEN event_fire is called by Event.subscribe THEN it is called with the lock held; with the always-1 lock_tryget this does not deadlock (subscribe.tcl:54; eq3/event.tcl:25)
WHEN Event.unsubscribe is called for a session that is not subscribed THEN false is returned and subscriber.list is not rewritten (unchanged)

input_shape._session_id_: string; used as queue file name and subscriber key

output_shape.subscribe/unsubscribe: boolean (subscribe may return a quoted string on internal failure)
output_shape.poll: array<{type: string ('init'|'delete'|...), data: raw JSON value (null for init, string for delete)}>

user_stories.goal: Read and rewrite the BidCoS-RF (rfd.conf) and BidCoS-Wired (hs485d.conf) gateway configuration, manage the system security key file and prepare LAN gateway key changes (BidCoS_RF.getConfigurationRF/setConfigurationRF/createKeyFile/isKeySet/validateKey, BidCoS_Wired.getConfigurationWired/setConfigurationWired, BidCoS.changeLanGatewayKey)
acceptance: GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN BidCoS_RF.getConfigurationRF is called THEN /etc/config/rfd.conf is parsed into sections and {interfaces:[{type,userName,serialNumber,encryptionKey,ipAddress}]} is returned for every section whose Type is not 'CCU2' (getconfiguration-rf.tcl:20-119; methods.conf:910-915)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN BidCoS_Wired.getConfigurationWired is called THEN /etc/config/hs485d.conf is parsed likewise, with no Type filtering (getconfiguration-wired.tcl:20-119; methods.conf:1179-1184)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and interfaces[] WHEN BidCoS_RF.setConfigurationRF is called THEN rfd.conf is rewritten: header lines before the first '[Interface N]' (N in 1-9 digits) are kept and one '[Interface i]' section per element (Type, Name, Serial Number, Encryption Key, optional IP Address) is appended from i=1; true is returned (setconfiguration-rf.tcl:15-69; methods.conf:917-922)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and interfaces[] WHEN BidCoS_Wired.setConfigurationWired is called THEN hs485d.conf is rewritten the same way with interface numbering from 0 and a generated header if the file does not exist; true is returned (setconfiguration-wired.tcl:15-85; methods.conf:1186-1191)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and key WHEN BidCoS_RF.createKeyFile is called THEN /etc/config/keys is written with Current Index, 'Key 0 =', the md5 hex of the key for the current and previous indexes reported by 'crypttool -g', and Last Index (createkeyfile.tcl:13-62; methods.conf:924-929)
GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN BidCoS_RF.validateKey(key) is called THEN `crypttool -v -t 3 -k <key>` is executed and false is returned if it exits non-zero, otherwise true (validatekey.tcl:10-14)

GIVEN an ADMIN session and a non-empty lgwserial WHEN BidCoS.changeLanGatewayKey is called THEN /etc/config//<lgwserial>.keychange is written with Class, Serial, IP, KEY, CURKEY lines and true is returned; with an empty lgwserial false is returned (changeLanGatewayKey.tcl:21-38; methods.conf:1192-1198)

GIVEN setConfigurationRF or setConfigurationWired is called WHEN the new file is generated THEN the content is written to a temporary file in /etc/config and moved over rfd.conf / hs485d.conf with rename only after the full content was produced; a failure (malformed element, unreadable source, empty header) leaves the previous file byte-identical and returns false/200 (no truncated or empty config) [TARGET]

GIVEN an interfaces[] element whose userName, serialNumber, encryptionKey or ipAddress contains CR or LF WHEN validated THEN the call is rejected with error 403 "invalid argument (interfaces)" (locked, BD-02/BD-10) and the file is not touched (no config-line injection) [TARGET]

GIVEN BidCoS.changeLanGatewayKey with lgwserial containing '/' or '..' or not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$ WHEN validated THEN error 403 "invalid argument (lgwserial)" is returned and no file is written; with lgwserial 'OEQ1234567' /etc/config/OEQ1234567.keychange is written atomically (the as-is double slash '/etc/config//' is normalised) [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN setConfigurationRF searches for the header end THEN the pattern '\[Interface [1-9]*\]' does not match '[Interface 0]', so Interface 0 stays in the retained header; the wired variant matches '[0-9]*' and drops all interface sections (setconfiguration-rf.tcl:20; setconfiguration-wired.tcl:29)

user_stories.goal: Session.login/logout/renew/setSessionVar (and the unregistered Session.create) manage ReGa web sessions by calling the local lighttpd login page and the ReGa session functions
acceptance: GIVEN valid username/password WHEN Session.login (LEVEL NONE, methods.conf:783-788) is called THEN the script POSTs tbUsername/tbPassword via ::http::geturl -query to http://127.0.0.1/login.htm (login.tcl:15,45), extracts the session id with regexp 'sid=@([^@]*)@' from the Location header (login.tcl:46,54) and returns it as a JSON string via json_toString (login.tcl:58) (happy path)

GIVEN the login page answers with an HTTP status line containing '503' WHEN Session.login runs THEN jsonrpc_error 503 'service not available' is returned and the script exits (login.tcl:47,50-52) (failure path)

GIVEN wrong credentials or the session limit is reached (no 'sid=@...@' in Location) WHEN Session.login runs THEN jsonrpc_error 501 'invalid credentials or too many sessions' (login.tcl:54-56) (failure path)

GIVEN a valid session of at least GUEST level WHEN Session.renew (LEVEL GUEST, methods.conf:797-802) runs THEN a loopback GET http://127.0.0.1/pages/index.htm?sid=@<sid>@ is issued and discarded (renew.tcl:15-17) and the response is true (renew.tcl:19) (happy path)

GIVEN an expired/unknown session id WHEN Session.renew is called THEN the dispatcher's privilege check (getupl.hms yields 0 < GUEST=1) rejects it with error 400 'access denied ("GUEST" needed 0)' before the script runs (homematic.cgi:103-117) (failure path)

GIVEN params var and val WHEN Session.setSessionVar (LEVEL GUEST, ARGUMENTS {var val}, methods.conf:804-809) runs THEN hmscript executes system.SetSessionVar(var,val) with all params injected as script variables and returns true (setsessionvar.tcl:11-13) (happy path)
GIVEN a request Session.logout with a valid sid of any level >= GUEST WHEN it runs THEN system.ClearSessionID(sid) is executed and true is returned; Session.logout is now LEVEL GUEST [TARGET]

GIVEN Session.logout with an unknown, expired or missing _session_id_ WHEN the dispatcher runs THEN error 400 "access denied (\"GUEST\" needed ...)" (unknown/expired) or 402 "missing argument (_session_id_)" (absent) is returned and ClearSessionID is not executed (a caller who merely knows an id can no longer terminate other sessions without holding a valid session) [TARGET]

GIVEN Session.setSessionVar {_session_id_:<valid>, var:'k', val:'v'} WHEN called THEN system.SetSessionVar is executed for the session and true returned; without _session_id_ the answer is 402 "missing argument (_session_id_)" (ARGUMENTS corrected) [TARGET]

GIVEN POST /api/v2/rpc with Session.login WHEN the credentials are valid and cookie mode is enabled by configuration (opt-in, default OFF) THEN the response additionally sets a session cookie with attributes HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Path=/api and the body still returns the sid string [V2]

GIVEN rate_limit=true (login_ip_limit 10, login_ip_window_seconds 60) and 10 Session.login calls (any outcome) from REMOTE_ADDR=192.0.2.10 within the last 60 s WHEN the 11th Session.login from REMOTE_ADDR=192.0.2.10 arrives within that 60 s THEN JSON-RPC error 429 "rate limit exceeded" is returned (HTTP 200 on /api/homematic.cgi; HTTP 429 with header Retry-After of 1..60 seconds on /api/v2/rpc), login.htm is not contacted (0 ::http::geturl calls) and the credentials are not evaluated [TARGET]

GIVEN the counter state of acceptance[10] (192.0.2.10 at 10 of 10) WHEN a Session.login arrives from REMOTE_ADDR=192.0.2.11 THEN it is processed normally (501/503/sid as in v1) because the counter is per client IP (REMOTE_ADDR only; X-Forwarded-For is ignored) and the first 10 attempts of every IP in a 60 s window are never limited [TARGET]

GIVEN 192.0.2.10 reached 10 attempts at t=0 s WHEN a Session.login arrives from 192.0.2.10 at t=61 s THEN the window has expired, the counter restarts at 1 and the request is processed normally (no 429) [TARGET]

GIVEN the default configuration (rate_limit=false, strict_mode=false, request on /api/homematic.cgi) WHEN 11 or 100 Session.login calls arrive from REMOTE_ADDR=192.0.2.10 within 60 s THEN none returns error 429, every response is exactly the unchanged v1 outcome (sid, 501 or 503), no counter file is created and the 133-method golden fixtures stay green (NFR-045) [TARGET]

GIVEN rate_limit=false but strict_mode=true (or a POST on /api/v2/rpc) WHEN the 11th Session.login within 60 s arrives from REMOTE_ADDR=192.0.2.10 THEN error 429 "rate limit exceeded" is returned exactly as in acceptance[10] (the limiter is always enforced in strict/v2 mode) [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN Session.login is called with missing username or password THEN dispatcher returns 402 'missing argument (<name>)' (ARGUMENTS {username password}, homematic.cgi:127-130)
WHEN the loopback connection to 127.0.0.1 fails THEN ::http::geturl raises a Tcl error and the caller receives error 200 'internal error:' + errorInfo (login.tcl:45, homematic.cgi:155)
WHEN Session.login is called with a session id containing '@' characters in Location THEN the regexp [^@]* captures only up to the next '@' (login.tcl:54)
WHEN Session.renew is called for a valid session THEN the response is true regardless of whether the GET produced a refreshed session (renew.tcl:17-19)
WHEN Session.create (session/create.tcl) is requested THEN it stays unregistered and returns 401 "method not found (Session.create)"
WHEN a v2 client sends the sid in the header X-Session-Id and also params._session_id_ with a different value THEN the header value wins and a syslog line is written (header name locked, BD-05)

WHEN the per-IP login limiter runs THEN the client IP is taken from REMOTE_ADDR only (X-Forwarded-For and Forwarded are ignored), the counter lives in one file per IP under /tmp/webui-ratelimit/ (name login-<REMOTE_ADDR with characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] mapped to '_'>) holding the attempt timestamps of the last login_ip_window_seconds (60), and the file is replaced by write-to-temp-then-rename so a reader never sees a partial file; two concurrent requests may lose at most one increment (accepted, documented, fail-open by 1)

WHEN the limiter is active (rate_limit=true, strict_mode=true or /api/v2) and the counter file is unreadable or /tmp/webui-ratelimit/ cannot be created THEN the request is processed unthrottled and one syslog line 'rate limiter unavailable' with the correlation id is written (availability over throttling; the privilege and credential checks stay fail-closed)

WHEN rate_limit is false (default) and neither strict_mode nor /api/v2 applies THEN the limiter code path is skipped entirely: no /tmp/webui-ratelimit/ access, no 429, identical v1 behaviour (EG-17 brute-force mitigation is therefore active only when rate_limit is on or in strict/v2 mode)

input_shape.v2 header X-Session-Id: string, optional sid carrier on v2 (name provisional)
input_shape.env.REMOTE_ADDR: client IP string set by lighttpd; key of the per-IP Session.login limiter (login_ip_limit 10 per login_ip_window_seconds 60); only used when rate_limit=true, strict_mode=true or /api/v2

GIVEN name='CCU.getVersion' WHEN system.methodHelp (LEVEL NONE, ARGUMENTS {name}, methods.conf:15-20) runs THEN it returns the INFO text as a JSON string (methodhelp.tcl:14,20) (happy path)
GIVEN a name not present in METHOD_LIST WHEN system.methodHelp runs THEN jsonrpc_error 500 'unknown method (<name>)' (methodhelp.tcl:16-18) (failure path)

GIVEN GET /api/v2/schema with a valid sid (GUEST or higher) and X-Requested-With WHEN processed THEN HTTP 200 returns {"version":<string>,"methods":[{"name":"Device.listAll","level":"GUEST","info":<string>,"params":<JSON Schema object>,"result":<JSON Schema>}]} with exactly 179 entries; without a valid sid HTTP 401 [V2]

GIVEN userName and userLang WHEN User.setLanguage (USER, methods.conf:1231-1236) runs THEN the file /etc/config/userprofiles/<file tail of userName>.lang is overwritten with userLang without trailing newline and true is returned (setlanguage.tcl:14-25) (happy path)
GIVEN the profile directory is not writable WHEN User.setLanguage runs THEN jsonrpc_error 500 'could not write user profile' (setlanguage.tcl:17-23) (failure path)

GIVEN userID that does not resolve to a ReGa object WHEN User.getUserName / getUserFirstName / hasUserPWD runs THEN hmscript prints 'false', 'array set user' receives a one-element list and Tcl raises 'list must have an even number of elements', returned as error 200 'internal error:' (getusername.tcl:20,24; getuserfirstname.tcl:20,24; hasuserpwd.tcl:27,32) (failure path)

GIVEN GET /api/v2/profile with a valid USER sid, X-Requested-With and Accept application/json WHEN processed THEN HTTP 200 returns strict JSON {"userId":"1234","userName":"Admin","firstName":"Max","hasPassword":true,"isNoExpert":false,"language":"de"} (attribute set locked, BD-11, re-baselined: no reGaVersion attribute); no JavaScript expression text is ever returned [V2]

GIVEN User.getUserName / getUserFirstName / hasUserPWD are called on /api/v2/rpc WHEN they succeed THEN the result is a plain JSON value ("Admin", "Max", true) instead of the v1 JS expression with .UserName/.UserPWD [V2]

user_stories.goal: Lifecycle and certificate control: service restarts (lighttpd, HmIP server, sshd, ReGa), certificate presence/removal and the SafeMode.enter / RecoveryMode.enter reboots, all ADMIN-level

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN User.restartHmIPServer / stopHmIPServer / startHmIPServer run THEN '/usr/bin/nohup /etc/init.d/S62HMServer restart|stop|start >/dev/null &' is started in the background and true is returned immediately (restarthmipserver.tcl:11-12, stophmipserver.tcl:10-11, starthmipserver.tcl:10-11) (happy path)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN CCU.restartReGa (methods.conf:1082-1087) or CCU.restartSSHDaemon (methods.conf:1075-1080) run THEN 'monit restart ReGaHss' / 'monit restart sshd' is executed inside catch and the response result is null (restartReGa.tcl:10-12, restartsshdaemon.tcl:10-12) (happy path)

GIVEN /etc/config/server.pem exists WHEN User.existsCertificate (ADMIN, methods.conf:1252-1257) runs THEN true, else false (existscertificate.tcl:10-16); User.deleteCertificate (ADMIN) deletes /etc/config/server.pem inside catch and always returns true (deletecertificate.tcl:10-12) (happy path)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN SafeMode.enter (methods.conf:973-978, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_}) runs THEN /etc/config/safemode is written containing '1', ReGa persists with 'rega system.Save()', a background '/sbin/reboot -d 2' is launched and true is returned (enter.tcl:12-23) (happy path)
GIVEN /etc/config is not writable WHEN SafeMode.enter runs THEN open raises a Tcl error, no reboot is triggered and the caller receives error 200 'internal error:' (enter.tcl:15) (failure path)
GIVEN the monit binary or restart command fails WHEN User.restartLighttpd runs THEN exec raises, uncaught, and error 200 'internal error:' is returned (restartlighttpd.tcl:10) (failure path)

GIVEN any of User.restartLighttpd, User.restartHmIPServer, User.stopHmIPServer, User.startHmIPServer, CCU.restartReGa, CCU.restartSSHDaemon, User.deleteCertificate, SafeMode.enter is executed WHEN it runs THEN the command line is a fixed argument list with no request data and one syslog line records method, user id and correlation id [TARGET]
GIVEN SafeMode.enter WHEN /etc/config/safemode is written THEN it is written write-then-rename containing '1' and the reboot is launched only after the file was moved into place [TARGET]

GIVEN an ADMIN session and /VERSION containing PLATFORM=rpi4 WHEN RecoveryMode.enter (ADMIN, methods.conf, SCRIPT_FILE recoverymode/enter.tcl, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_}) runs THEN rega system.Save() is executed, the flag file /usr/local/.recoveryMode is written containing '1', a background '/sbin/reboot -d 2' is launched and true is returned (recoverymode/enter.tcl:11-50) (happy path)

GIVEN /VERSION is missing or has no PLATFORM line WHEN RecoveryMode.enter runs THEN error 500 "could not determine the platform from /VERSION" is returned and neither Save, flag file nor reboot happens (recoverymode/enter.tcl:14-24) (failure path)

GIVEN /VERSION with PLATFORM=oci or PLATFORM=lxc WHEN RecoveryMode.enter runs THEN error 501 "recovery mode is not supported on platform oci" (resp. lxc) is returned and nothing is written (recoverymode/enter.tcl:25-27) (failure path)
GIVEN rega system.Save() raises WHEN RecoveryMode.enter runs THEN error 500 "could not save the settings: <err>" is returned and no flag file is created (recoverymode/enter.tcl:30-32) (failure path)

GIVEN /usr/local is not writable WHEN RecoveryMode.enter runs THEN the flag file is removed (file delete -force) and error 500 "could not create the recovery mode flag: <err>" is returned (recoverymode/enter.tcl:35-42) (failure path)

GIVEN '/sbin/reboot -d 2' cannot be started WHEN RecoveryMode.enter runs THEN the flag file /usr/local/.recoveryMode is removed and error 500 "could not restart: <err>" is returned (recoverymode/enter.tcl:45-48) (failure path)

GIVEN RecoveryMode.enter is called with a USER or GUEST session or without sid WHEN dispatched THEN error 400 (permission denied) / 402 (missing argument _session_id_) is returned before the script runs; the script reads no request parameter, so no request data reaches exec; on /api/v2/rpc the 500/501 messages carry neither errorInfo nor file paths, while v1 messages stay as-is (frozen contract) [TARGET]

WHEN User.deleteCertificate is called and the file does not exist THEN the response is still true (deletecertificate.tcl:10-12)
WHEN CCU.restartReGa/restartSSHDaemon fail THEN the failure is swallowed by catch and the result is null (restartReGa.tcl:10-12)

WHEN CCU.createFile is requested for a path outside its allow-list THEN error 500 'path not allowed'; further existsFile/createFile paths or patterns require an allow-list config entry, never a request value (EG-3 resolved and corrected 2026-10-20) [TARGET]

WHEN a pattern-matched name part is empty, contains '/' or NUL, exceeds 200 characters (userAckInstallWizard_) or is not 1 to 10 digits (userAckInstallWizardId_) THEN CCU.existsFile answers error 500 'path not allowed' without any filesystem call [TARGET]

input_shape.file: string absolute path, required; must exactly match the method's exact allow-list or (existsFile only) one of the 2 anchored patterns; the string is matched as given, no normalisation

output_shape.result: boolean (createFile: true if touch printed nothing; existsFile: file exists)

user_stories.goal: SSH management: CCU.setSSH, CCU.getSSHState, CCU.setSSHPassword (ADMIN) toggle the sshEnabled flag file, report its presence and replace root's password hash in /etc/config/shadow
acceptance: GIVEN mode == 'true' WHEN CCU.setSSH (ADMIN, methods.conf:1028-1032) runs THEN '/etc/config/sshEnabled' is created via touch, otherwise (any other value) removed via rm, both inside catch; then /bin/setfirewall.tcl is sourced to reload and apply the firewall; result null (setssh.tcl:11-21) (happy path)
GIVEN the flag file exists WHEN CCU.getSSHState (ADMIN, methods.conf:1034-1038) runs THEN result is 1 else 0 (getsshstate.tcl:10-12) (happy path)
GIVEN /bin/setfirewall.tcl fails to source WHEN CCU.setSSH runs THEN the error propagates as 200 'internal error:' after the flag file has already changed (setssh.tcl:19) (failure path)

GIVEN passwd='-nS3cret' WHEN CCU.setSSHPassword runs THEN the password is passed to 'mkpasswd -m sha512 -s' on stdin (never on a command line, no echo, no shell pipeline), the resulting hash replaces the root: password field of /etc/config/shadow via Tcl file rewrite written write-then-rename, and the response is {"msg":"noError"} [TARGET]

GIVEN mkpasswd is missing or exits non-zero WHEN CCU.setSSHPassword runs THEN /etc/config/shadow is unchanged and the response is error 200 with correlation id (the failing exec is inside the dispatcher catch, no errorInfo to the client) [TARGET]
GIVEN /etc/config/shadow is missing or has no root: line WHEN CCU.setSSHPassword runs THEN {"msg":"shadow update failed"} is returned (generic text, no path) and nothing is written [TARGET]

GIVEN CCU.setSSH mode='true' WHEN it runs THEN /etc/config/sshEnabled is created with touch -- (argument list) and /bin/setfirewall.tcl is sourced; mode other than the exact string 'true' removes the flag (unchanged semantics)
non_functional_requirements: WHEN mode is the boolean true from JSON THEN it is compared as the string 'true'; anything else (including 'TRUE', 1) disables SSH (setssh.tcl:13)

user_stories.goal: CCU.downloadFirmware (ADMIN) downloads the latest CCU2/CCU3 firmware tarball over HTTPS with wget into /tmp/fup.tgz
acceptance: GIVEN /VERSION major version 3 WHEN CCU.downloadFirmware (ADMIN, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_}, methods.conf:1047-1052) runs THEN serial is read from /var/board_serial, the URL https://ccu3-update.homematic.com/firmware/download?cmd=download&version=<v>&serial=<s>&lang=de&product=HM-CCU3 is built (downloadFirmware.tcl:11-15) and wget -q --https-only -O /tmp/fup.tgz <url> is run; exit 0 returns true (downloadFirmware.tcl:24-31) (happy path)

GIVEN major version 2 WHEN the method runs THEN serial comes from /sys/module/plat_eq3ccu2/parameters/board_serial and https://update.homematic.com/... product=HM-CCU2 is used (downloadFirmware.tcl:16-18) (happy path)
GIVEN wget fails WHEN the method runs THEN the error text is written to /tmp/dwnld.error and the response is false (downloadFirmware.tcl:24-34) (failure path)

GIVEN major version neither 2 nor 3 WHEN CCU.downloadFirmware runs THEN exactly one response document 'false' is emitted (the script exits after the first jsonrpc_response), no wget is started and nothing is appended to /tmp/test [TARGET]

GIVEN wget runs longer than the configured download timeout (300 s, locked by BD-09, EG-4) WHEN the timeout elapses THEN wget is terminated, /tmp/dwnld.error receives 'timeout' and the response is false; the CGI process never blocks beyond timeout + 5 s [TARGET]

GIVEN the download succeeds WHEN the method returns THEN a single document {"result":true} is emitted and /tmp/fup.tgz is replaced atomically (download to a temp name, rename on exit status 0) [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN /VERSION does not contain a VERSION= line THEN the grep|sed pipeline errors are only stored in the unchecked catch result and $version/$major carry the error message (downloadFirmware.tcl:11-12)
WHEN the request is served THEN lang=de and the product name are hard-coded (downloadFirmware.tcl:15,18)
WHEN a previous /tmp/fup.tgz exists THEN wget -O overwrites it; no size, checksum or signature check is performed in this method (downloadFirmware.tcl:24)
WHEN wget fails THEN the failure text is written to /tmp/dwnld.error (unchanged) and the HTTP response contains only false, never the wget stderr or URL with serial

user_stories.goal: Security configuration: CCU security level, service authentication, HTTPS redirect, SNMP, and acknowledgement flag files (CCU.get/setSecurityLevel, get/setAuthEnabled, get/setHttpsRedirectEnabled, get/setSNMPEnabled, setSecurityHint, setFirewallConfigured, setUserAckInstallWizard)
acceptance: GIVEN level in {LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH} (case-sensitive) WHEN CCU.setSecurityLevel (ADMIN, methods.conf:987-992) runs THEN /lib/libsecuritylevel.tcl is sourced, SEC_setsecuritylevel <level> is called and true/false is returned from its truth value (setsecuritylevel.tcl:14-26) (happy path)
GIVEN any other level string WHEN CCU.setSecurityLevel runs THEN the response is false and nothing is changed (setsecuritylevel.tcl:24-26) (failure path)

GIVEN an ADMIN session WHEN CCU.getSecurityLevel (methods.conf:980-985) runs THEN SEC_getsecuritylevel is returned as a JSON string (LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH per the script comment) (getsecuritylevel.tcl:13-17) (happy path)

GIVEN enabled == 'true' or 'false' WHEN CCU.setAuthEnabled (ADMIN, methods.conf:1130-1135) runs THEN SEC_setAuthEnabled true|false is called and its outcome is mapped to true/false; any other value returns false (setauthenabled.tcl:13-32); CCU.getAuthEnabled returns integer 1 or 0 from SEC_getAuthEnabled (getauthenabled.tcl:10-16) (happy path)

GIVEN CCU.getHttpsRedirectEnabled (ADMIN, methods.conf:1137-1142) WHEN run THEN result is the Tcl boolean from 'file exists /etc/config/httpsRedirectEnabled' (1/0) (gethttpsredirectenabled.tcl:10-12) (happy path)

GIVEN enabled=true, usr, pass WHEN CCU.setSNMPEnabled (ADMIN, methods.conf:1172-1177) runs THEN libfirewall config is loaded, /bin/setSNMPUser.sh <usr> <pass> is executed, service access SNMP is set to 'full', the firewall config is saved and applied, and the response is {"msg":"noError"} (setsnmpenabled.tcl:13-38) (happy path)
GIVEN enabled=false WHEN CCU.setSNMPEnabled runs THEN /bin/unsetSNMPUser.sh is executed and SNMP access is set to 'none' (setsnmpenabled.tcl:27-30) (happy path)

GIVEN the SNMP helper script exits non-zero WHEN CCU.setSNMPEnabled runs THEN the firewall access is changed in memory only, the config is NOT saved/applied and the helper's error text is returned in {"msg": <text>} as a normal result (setsnmpenabled.tcl:25-40) (failure path)

GIVEN USER session WHEN CCU.setSecurityHint (methods.conf:1054-1059) runs THEN /etc/config/userAckSecurityHint is touched in catch and true is returned (setsecurityhint.tcl:12-14); CCU.setFirewallConfigured (ADMIN) touches /etc/config/firewallConfigured and returns true (setfirewallconfigured.tcl:11-13) (happy path)

GIVEN a GUEST session whose session var carries a numeric user id (index 0 of the ';'-separated GetSessionVarStr) WHEN CCU.setUserAckInstallWizard (GUEST, methods.conf:1061-1066) runs THEN /etc/config/userprofiles/userAckInstallWizardId_<id> is touched and, if optional legacyName matches ^[!-.0-~]+$, userAckInstallWizard_<legacyName> is deleted; true is returned (setuserackinstallwizard.tcl:15-31) (happy path)
GIVEN the session var does not yield digits WHEN CCU.setUserAckInstallWizard runs THEN nothing is touched and true is still returned (setuserackinstallwizard.tcl:21-31) (failure path)

GIVEN enabled='true' WHEN CCU.setHttpsRedirectEnabled runs THEN /etc/config/httpsRedirectEnabled is created, the surrounding boolean test no longer evaluates the empty exec output and the response is true (no error 200); enabled='false' removes the file and returns true; any other value returns false without touching the file [TARGET]
GIVEN a failure of touch or rm (read-only /etc/config) WHEN CCU.setHttpsRedirectEnabled runs THEN the response is false and the error is logged to syslog [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN CCU.getSNMPEnabled (ADMIN, methods.conf:1165-1170) runs THEN it reports 1 whenever /etc/config/snmp/snmpd-ccu3.conf exists, because the emptiness test compares the literal word 'data' (not $data) with '' (getsnmpenabled.tcl:16); the opened file handle is never closed (getsnmpenabled.tcl:14)

WHEN enabled is the string 'true'/'false' THEN setAuthEnabled and setHttpsRedirectEnabled compare strings exactly; the numeric 1/0 documented in their comments is not accepted (setauthenabled.tcl:17,23; sethttpsredirectenabled.tcl:16,22)
WHEN CCU.setSNMPEnabled receives non-boolean 'enabled' THEN 'if { $enable }' raises a Tcl error returned as 200 'internal error:' (setsnmpenabled.tcl:24)
WHEN usr/pass contain shell-meaningful characters THEN they are passed as exec arguments (not through a shell), after '--' (setsnmpenabled.tcl:25)
WHEN legacyName contains characters outside [!-.0-~] (e.g. '/' or space) THEN the legacy file is not deleted (setuserackinstallwizard.tcl:26)
WHEN CCU.getSNMPEnabled is evaluated THEN v1 keeps the as-is behaviour (1 whenever snmpd-ccu3.conf exists; defect not on the plan's fix list, EG-15)

output_shape.setHttpsRedirectEnabled.result: error 200 for both enabled values (as written)

user_stories.goal: CCU identity and device-state reads/flags: getSerial, getAddress, getHmIPAddress, getVersion, getHeatingGroupList, get/setInfoLedConfig, hideStickyUnreach/getStickyUnreachState, removeFieldTestActive (all ADMIN)
acceptance: GIVEN /var/ids contains 'SerialNumber=<x>' WHEN CCU.getSerial (ADMIN, methods.conf:994-999) runs THEN <x> is returned as a JSON string (getserial.tcl:23-27); CCU.getAddress reads 'BidCos-Address' from /var/ids (getaddress.tcl:24); CCU.getHmIPAddress reads 'Adapter.1.Address' from /etc/config/hmip_address.conf (gethmipaddress.tcl:24); CCU.getVersion reads VERSION from /VERSION (getversion.tcl:24) (happy path)

GIVEN a readable key=value file WHEN a read_var-based getter runs THEN the first line matching '^ *<key> *= *(.*)$' wins and its group 1 is returned, or '' when the key is absent (getserial.tcl:11-21) (happy path)

GIVEN the source file does not exist WHEN a read_var-based getter runs THEN 'open' raises (the '$fd >= 0' test is ineffective) and the caller gets error 200 'internal error:' (getserial.tcl:12; getaddress.tcl:12; gethmipaddress.tcl:12; getversion.tcl:12) (failure path)

GIVEN /etc/config/groups.gson exists WHEN CCU.getHeatingGroupList (methods.conf:1001-1006) runs THEN the entire file content is returned as one JSON string; if it cannot be opened the JSON string "-1" is returned (getheatinggrouplist.tcl:11-21) (happy path/failure path)

GIVEN service/alarm LED flags WHEN CCU.setInfoLedConfig (methods.conf:1158-1163, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_ serviceLedOn alarmLedOn}) runs THEN /etc/config/hss_led_info.conf is overwritten with IgnoreServiceMessages=<true if serviceLedOn=='false'> and IgnoreAlarmMessages=<true if alarmLedOn=='false'> and true is returned (setinfoledconfig.tcl:18-32) (happy path)

GIVEN CCU.getInfoLedConfig runs WHEN the config file is missing or lacks keys THEN both flags default to on, and the result is an object with unquoted booleans {"serviceLedOn":true,"alarmLedOn":true} (getinfoledconfig.tcl:32-50) (happy path)

GIVEN mode=='true' WHEN CCU.hideStickyUnreach (script setstickyunreach.tcl, methods.conf:1089-1093) runs THEN /etc/config/hideStickyUnreach is touched, else removed (setstickyunreach.tcl:11-19); CCU.getStickyUnreachState returns 1/0 for its existence (getstickyunreachstate.tcl:10-12); CCU.removeFieldTestActive removes /etc/config/fieldTestActive and returns true only if rm printed nothing (removeFieldTestActive.tcl:13-22) (happy path)
GIVEN /etc/config is not writable WHEN CCU.setInfoLedConfig runs THEN open raises and the caller gets error 200 'internal error:' (setinfoledconfig.tcl:27) (failure path)

GIVEN CCU.setInfoLedConfig {serviceLedOn:'false', alarmLedOn:'true'} WHEN it writes /etc/config/hss_led_info.conf THEN the content 'IgnoreServiceMessages=true\nIgnoreAlarmMessages=false' (as before) is written write-then-rename so a failure never leaves a truncated file [TARGET]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN CCU.removeFieldTestActive is called and the file does not exist THEN rm prints an error, exec raises, catch captures it and the response is false (removeFieldTestActive.tcl:16-22)
WHEN serviceLedOn/alarmLedOn are given as anything other than the string 'false' THEN the LED is treated as on (setinfoledconfig.tcl:20-25)
WHEN getInfoLedConfig is documented THEN the comment says the values are strings ("true") but the code emits bare JSON booleans (getinfoledconfig.tcl:16,50)
WHEN hss_led_info.conf exists but a key is absent THEN read_var returns '' and the LED is reported on (getinfoledconfig.tcl:35-46)

user_stories.goal: SysVar read operations: SysVar.getAll, SysVar.get, SysVar.getValue, SysVar.getValueByName return system-variable metadata/values from ReGa as JSON
acceptance: GIVEN a USER session WHEN SysVar.getAll (USER, methods.conf:839-844) runs THEN a ReGa script enumerates ID_SYSTEM_VARIABLES, maps ValueSubType to type ALARM|LOGIC|LIST|NUMBER|STRING|UNKNOWN (getall.tcl:44-48), and the Tcl side emits [{id,name,type,unit,value,channelId,[valueName0,valueName1 for ALARM/LOGIC | valueList for LIST | minValue,maxValue for NUMBER],isLogged,isVisible,isInternal}] (getall.tcl:75-106) (happy path)

GIVEN id of an existing system variable WHEN SysVar.get (USER, methods.conf:846-851) runs THEN the same object is returned for that single variable looked up with ID_SYSTEM_VARIABLES.Get(id) (get.tcl:35,66-91) (happy path)
GIVEN id / name WHEN SysVar.getValue (id) or SysVar.getValueByName (name) runs THEN the current value is returned as a JSON string (getvalue.tcl:13-21; getvaluebyname.tcl:13-21) (happy path)

GIVEN id that does not exist WHEN SysVar.get runs THEN the ReGa script prints nothing, '$_sv_(TYPE)' is read from an empty array and Tcl raises, returned as error 200 'internal error:' + stack trace (get.tcl:62-64) (failure path)
GIVEN id/name that does not exist WHEN SysVar.getValue / getValueByName runs THEN the result is the empty JSON string "" (getvalue.tcl:15-21) (failure path)

GIVEN GET /api/v2/model?sections=sysvars&limit=100&offset=0 WHEN the system has 250 system variables THEN the response section 'sysvars' has total 250 and 100 items, each with real JSON booleans for isLogged/isVisible/isInternal and the same field names as SysVar.getAll [V2]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN SysVar.getAll runs THEN every property, including bool values isLogged/isVisible/isInternal, is spliced into the JSON unquoted straight from ReGa output ('true'/'false') while value and numeric properties are returned as JSON strings (getall.tcl:81-104)
WHEN a variable name or value contains unbalanced braces or Tcl list metacharacters THEN the 'foreach sv $svList' / 'array set' Tcl list parsing can fail or mis-split (getall.tcl:75-77)
WHEN type is STRING or UNKNOWN THEN no type-specific fields are emitted (getall.tcl:88-100)

WHEN the array _sv_ is reused across loop iterations without being unset THEN stale keys from previous variables remain (getall.tcl:77); type-specific fields are only appended for matching types, so exposure is limited
WHEN SysVar.getAll is called on v1 THEN the unpaginated full list and field types are unchanged (frozen)

user_stories.goal: SysVar create/set/delete: SysVar.createBool, createFloat, createEnum, setBool, setFloat, setEnum, deleteSysVarByName (USER level) mutate ReGa system variables
acceptance: GIVEN name matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.:]+$, init_val a Tcl boolean, internal an integer and chnID an integer WHEN SysVar.createBool (USER, methods.conf:865-869) runs THEN a ReGa script creates an OT_VARDP (binary, istBool, ValueName0 'false', ValueName1 'true', State(init_val)), sets Internal if internal==1|'true', binds it to the channel when chnID != -1 and found, appends it to ID_SYSTEM_VARIABLES and returns {name,id,value} (createbool.tcl:14-58) (happy path)

GIVEN name, minValue, maxValue, internal, chnID WHEN SysVar.createFloat (methods.conf:877-881) runs THEN a float variable (ivtFloat, ValueMin/ValueMax, State 0) is created and returned as {name,id,value} (createfloat.tcl:15-59); SysVar.createEnum with valList matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_\-;,]+$ creates an ivtInteger/istEnum variable with ValueList(valList) and returns {name,id,value:<valueList>} (createenum.tcl:14-55) (happy path)

GIVEN an invalid name WHEN a create method runs THEN jsonrpc_error is returned with code 1 (createBool), 100 (createFloat, createEnum) and the message 'Invalid name. Must match [A-Za-z0-9_\-.:]' (createbool.tcl:14-16; createfloat.tcl:15-17; createenum.tcl:14-16) (failure path)

GIVEN non-numeric/boolean parameters WHEN a create method runs THEN error codes are createBool: 2 init_val, 3 internal, 4 chnID; createFloat: 101 minValue, 102 maxValue, 103 internal, 104 chnID; createEnum: 101 valList ('Invalid valList. Expected format: Wert1;Wert2;Wert3;...'), 102 internal, 103 chnID; messages are "Value '<v>' is not a valid <boolean|float|integer>" (hmscript.tcl:73-89) (failure path)

GIVEN name and value WHEN SysVar.setBool / setFloat (USER) run THEN the ReGa script calls sv.State(value) on ID_SYSTEM_VARIABLES.Get(name) and the response echoes args(value) when the script output is a Tcl-true value, else -1 (setbool.tcl:25-38; setfloat.tcl:14-27); setBool first normalises non-0/1 numerics to 1 if >= 1 else 0 (setbool.tcl:16-23) (happy path)

GIVEN name and valueList WHEN SysVar.setEnum runs THEN sv.ValueList(valueList) is called (replacing the enum's option list, not selecting a value) and the response is the quoted valueList (setenum.tcl:14-27) (happy path)

GIVEN name of an existing variable WHEN SysVar.deleteSysVarByName (methods.conf:904-909) runs THEN the variable id is removed from ID_SYSTEM_VARIABLES and true is returned (deletesysvarbyname.tcl:12-21) (happy path)

GIVEN name of a variable that does not exist WHEN setBool/setFloat/setEnum run THEN the ReGa script writes nothing, the empty string is evaluated by 'if {...}' and Tcl raises 'expected boolean value but got ""' returned as error 200 'internal error:' (setbool.tcl:34; setfloat.tcl:23; setenum.tcl:23) (failure path)

GIVEN SysVar.createBool {name:'Presence', init_val:true, internal:0, chnID:-1} on /api/v2/rpc and a system variable named 'Presence' already exists WHEN called THEN nothing is created and error 500 "name already exists (Presence)" is returned with HTTP 409 (same for createFloat and createEnum; v1 keeps creating duplicates, frozen; code provisional, EG-12) [V2]

GIVEN SysVar.createBool with name 'Presence' that does not exist on /api/v2/rpc WHEN called THEN {name:'Presence', id:<string>, value:<string>} is returned with HTTP 200 and exactly one variable named 'Presence' exists afterwards [V2]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN a create method is called twice with the same name THEN no uniqueness check exists and a second OT_VARDP with the same name is created (createbool.tcl:32-53)
WHEN chnID is not -1 but dom.GetObject(chnID) returns nothing THEN the variable is created unbound without error (createbool.tcl:28-30,48-51)
WHEN internal is the string 'true' THEN hmscript_assertInteger rejects it, so only integer values are accepted although the script also tests == "true" (createbool.tcl:20-22,42)
WHEN setBool value is not numeric THEN the Tcl expression '$val >= 1' raises and error 200 is returned (setbool.tcl:16-18)
WHEN setFloat value is arbitrary text THEN it is neither validated nor quoted in the response, producing invalid JSON if the script output is truthy (setfloat.tcl:19,24)

WHEN deleteSysVarByName is given a name that resolves to a non-sysvar object THEN dom.GetObject(name) is name-based over all ReGa objects and Remove(sysVar.ID()) is applied to the system-variable collection; for a missing object the ReGa behaviour of sysVar.ID() on a null object is not verifiable from source (see evidence gaps) (deletesysvarbyname.tcl:15-18)

user_stories.goal: Program operations: Program.getAll, Program.get, Program.execute, Program.deleteProgramByName (USER) list, inspect, run and delete ReGa programs
acceptance: GIVEN a USER session WHEN Program.getAll (methods.conf:811-816) runs THEN every object under ID_PROGRAMS is enumerated and returned as [{id,name,isActive,isInternal,lastExecuteTime}] with isActive/isInternal as unquoted ReGa booleans and lastExecuteTime as a string (getall.tcl:18-53) (happy path)
GIVEN id of an existing program WHEN Program.get (methods.conf:818-823) runs THEN the same fields are returned for one program (get.tcl:18-38) (happy path)

GIVEN id WHEN Program.execute (methods.conf:825-830) runs THEN program.ProgramExecute() is called and the response is true only if the ReGa output equals exactly 'true', otherwise false (execute.tcl:12-21) (happy path)
GIVEN id of a program that does not exist WHEN Program.execute runs THEN the ReGa script yields no 'true' output and the response is false (execute.tcl:13-21) (failure path)

GIVEN id of a program that does not exist WHEN Program.get runs THEN the script prints nothing and reading $_program_(ID) raises a Tcl error returned as 200 'internal error:' (get.tcl:30-33) (failure path)
GIVEN name WHEN Program.deleteProgramByName (USER, methods.conf:832-837) runs THEN dom.GetObject(name) is removed from ID_PROGRAMS and true is returned (deleteprogrambyname.tcl:12-21) (happy path)

GIVEN Program.get for an existing program on /api/v2/rpc WHEN called THEN the object is strict JSON without trailing comma: {"id":"1234","name":"Evening","isActive":true,"isInternal":false,"lastExecuteTime":"2026-10-12 21:00:00"} [V2]

GIVEN POST /api/v2/programs with Content-Type application/json, X-Requested-With and body {"id":"1234","isActive":false} from a USER session WHEN processed THEN a fixed server-side ReGa script (no client-supplied script text) sets the program's active flag and HTTP 200 {"id":"1234","isActive":false} is returned; a GUEST session gets HTTP 403, an unknown id HTTP 404 (operation set, levels and ReGa semantics are provisional until prototyped on a live ReGa, EG-6) [V2]
GIVEN POST /api/v2/programs with a body containing a key other than the documented fields (e.g. "script":"...") WHEN validated THEN HTTP 422 and the key is never forwarded to ReGa [V2]
non_functional_requirements: WHEN Program.get responds THEN the assembled JSON object has a trailing comma after lastExecuteTime ('..."lastExecuteTime":"..",}') and is therefore not strict JSON; the classic client parses with eval() (get.tcl:37-38; jsonrpc.js:66,90)
WHEN a program name contains Tcl list metacharacters THEN getAll's 'foreach program $programs' list parsing can mis-split records (getall.tcl:41-43)
WHEN Program.execute is called for a program the caller may not be allowed to run THEN there is no ownership/visibility check beyond USER level (execute.tcl:12-15)

WHEN Program.deleteProgramByName receives a name that does not match a program THEN the ReGa script dereferences a null object; the script's STDOUT is returned as-is, so the response is either 'true' or empty/null (deleteprogrambyname.tcl:14-18)
WHEN the program list is large THEN no pagination exists (getall.tcl:20-33)
WHEN Program.deleteProgramByName, Program.execute are called THEN USER level is kept (v1 frozen); tightening is a decision for EG-15

user_stories.goal: Room and Subsection (Gewerk/function) queries and membership edits: listAll, getAll, get, listProgramIds (GUEST) and addChannel, removeChannel (ADMIN), implemented as two near-identical method families
acceptance: GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Room.listAll (methods.conf:616-621) runs THEN the ids of rooms in ID_ROOMS.EnumUsedIDs() are returned as an array of strings (room/listall.tcl:12-34); Subsection.listAll does the same for ID_FUNCTIONS (subsection/listall.tcl:15,22-34) (happy path)

GIVEN a GUEST session WHEN Room.getAll / Subsection.getAll run THEN an array of {id,name,description,channelIds[]} is returned where description is EnumInfo() and channelIds are room.EnumUsedIDs() (room/getall.tcl:16-69; subsection/getall.tcl) (happy path)
GIVEN id of an existing room WHEN Room.get (methods.conf:630-635) runs THEN {id,name,description,channelIds[]} is returned (room/get.tcl:17-60) (happy path)

GIVEN id of a non-existent room WHEN Room.get runs THEN jsonrpc_error 501 'room not found' (room/get.tcl:40-42); Subsection.get returns 501 'function not found' (subsection/get.tcl:39-41) (failure path)

GIVEN id and channelId WHEN Room.addChannel / Subsection.addChannel (ADMIN, methods.conf:644-649, 686-691) run THEN room.Add(channelId) is invoked and 'true' is returned (room/addchannel.tcl:10-22); removeChannel calls room.Remove(channelId) (room/removechannel.tcl:10-22) (happy path)

GIVEN id of a non-existent room/subsection WHEN addChannel/removeChannel run THEN the script prints nothing and jsonrpc_error 500 'homematic script error' is returned (room/addchannel.tcl:21-25; room/removechannel.tcl:21-25) (failure path)

GIVEN a USER session WHEN system.getPositionData (methods.conf:28-33) runs THEN ReGa returns Longitude and Latitude and the script appends the time zone read from TIMEZONE in /etc/config/time.conf (default 'CET/CEST'), yielding the text ['Longitude:..','Latitude:..','TimeZone:..'] (getpositiondata.tcl:25-39) (happy path)

GIVEN a key WHEN system.getTweak (USER, ARGUMENTS {_session_id_ key}, methods.conf:42-47) runs THEN the first line matching '^ *<key> *= *(.*)$' in /etc/config/tweaks is returned verbatim; empty or missing yields the token false (gettweak.tcl:13-34) (happy path)

GIVEN a USER session WHEN system.saveObjectModel (methods.conf:21-26) runs THEN a ReGa script spawns "echo 'load tclrega.so; rega system.Save()' | /bin/tclsh &" through system.Exec and the response is true (saveobjectmodel.tcl:13-18) (happy path)

GIVEN system.getTweak {key:'a(b'} or any key not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$ WHEN validated THEN error 403 "invalid argument (key)" is returned (locked, BD-02/BD-10) instead of a regexp error surfacing as 200; the key is regexp-escaped before it is embedded in the pattern [TARGET]

GIVEN system.getPositionData / system.getTweak / system.getEnergyPrice are called on /api/v2/rpc WHEN they succeed THEN the result is strict JSON: getPositionData ["Longitude:8.4","Latitude:49.0","TimeZone:CET/CEST"] with double quotes, getTweak a JSON string or JSON false, getEnergyPrice {"Price":"0.30","Currency":"EUR"} (v1 keeps the single-quoted/raw forms, NFR-030) [V2]

user_stories.goal: Firewall configuration: Firewall.getConfiguration and Firewall.setConfiguration (ADMIN) read and apply services access, allowed IPs, user ports and mode via /lib/libfirewall.tcl

GIVEN a services element without a 'name' key WHEN Firewall.setConfiguration runs THEN $service(name) raises and the caller gets 200 'internal error:' while config in memory is partly modified but not saved (setconfiguration.tcl:34-38,50) (failure path)

GIVEN Firewall.setConfiguration with mode='BOGUS' WHEN Firewall_setMode runs THEN nothing is written to stdout (the text 'Firewall_setMode: Unsupported mode.' goes to syslog), the previous mode is kept, the remaining fields are applied and true is returned, so the HTTP response is a valid JSON-RPC document [TARGET]

GIVEN Firewall.setConfiguration on /api/v2/rpc with mode='BOGUS' or a service access outside full|restricted|none WHEN validated THEN HTTP 422 with error 403 "invalid argument (mode)" / "(services)" is returned and firewall.conf is unchanged (locked, BD-02/BD-10) [V2]

WHEN access is not one of full|restricted|none THEN it is stored unvalidated in firewall.conf (setconfiguration.tcl:38,42; libfirewall.tcl:215)
WHEN ips or userports contain arbitrary strings THEN they are written unvalidated as Tcl lists into firewall.conf ('IPs = ...', 'USERPORTS = ...') (libfirewall.tcl:199-207)
WHEN the services array order is returned THEN it follows Tcl 'array names' order, which is not stable (getconfiguration.tcl:32)
WHEN firewall.conf is absent THEN defaults apply (libfirewall.tcl:93-127)
WHEN Firewall_loadConfiguration migrates missing default ports THEN it rewrites firewall.conf as a side effect of a read-only getConfiguration call (libfirewall.tcl:141-149,174-176)
WHEN a service id in firewall.conf is unknown to the built-in table THEN '$Firewall_SERVICES($id)' raises on load (libfirewall.tcl:139)
